name: Valk 2 M
description: The Valk 2 LM is the newest iteration of the Valk 2 M. This 2x2 speed cube has a slightly lighter magnetic feel than its counterpart, giving it a faster, livelier feel with less turning resistance. Despite the lighter magnets, the Valk 2 LM still stands as one of the sturdiest, most stable flagship 2x2s on the market.
